subject: How I solved the error -  libRlapack.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

messages.author: faa5427c06a1e034
messages.subject: How I solved the error -  libRlapack.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
parts:
I was facing the following error (on CentOS 6.2, 32 bit, VM)

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : 
  unable to load shared object '/usr/local/lib/R/library/stats/libs/stats.so':
  libRlapack.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

This is how resolved this issue:

[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# ls /usr/local/lib/R/lib/
libRblas.so  libRlapack.so  libR.so
[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# 

I created a file by name libR.conf at /etc/ld.so.conf.d

Entered the following line:

[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# cat libR.conf
/usr/local/lib/R/lib/
[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# 

Executed ldconfig

[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# ldconfig
[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# 

Now I can see libR*

[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# ldconfig -v | grep R
/usr/local/lib/R/lib:
libRlapack.so -> libRlapack.so
libR.so -> libR.so
libRblas.so -> libRblas.so
libORBit-imodule-2.so.0 -> libORBit-imodule-2.so.0.0.0
libORBitCosNaming-2.so.0 -> libORBitCosNaming-2.so.0.1.0
libXRes.so.1 -> libXRes.so.1.0.0
libORBit-2.so.0 -> libORBit-2.so.0.1.0
[root@localhost ld.so.conf.d]# 

This resolved the issue:

Regards
